public_rationale: Tesla’s own filing, published before Marcus’s post, said its robotaxi business would begin launching in 2025 and would eventually operate fully autonomous vehicles. That is incompatible with substantial delivery of the quoted million-plus autonomous robotaxis by 2020. It supports Marcus’s ordinary meaning that the promise had failed.
limitations: The filing establishes launch status rather than an exact worldwide robotaxi count.
The conclusion concerns the promise discussed in the post, not Tesla’s later progress.

Next year in the quoted 2019 promise means 2020.
The target period covers the promised delivery year through Marcus’s publication date.
Robotaxis must operate autonomously; vehicles requiring an engaged driver do not satisfy the promise.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable deployment records establish delivery of over one million autonomous Tesla robotaxis by the promised 2020 deadline.
